title: Sidebars gone: no layout places a sidebar; the overview component, sidebar data model, TOC transformer, sidebar frontmatter and every sidebar, TOC, backlinks and grid-override rule go; one grid rule stays
first: Map: docs/masthead-campaign.md, section 'One column' (map revision 4), facts C2, C3, C4 and the paragraph 'No sidebar'. Ruling: operator-chromeless-column ('I also want those sidecars all gone'). Based on 535d170; after composite-delete the page body is GameCultContent.tsx and tour.md's frontmatter is one line shorter. Re-read by selector.

Placements (site/quartz.layout.ts): content layout left = DesktopOnly(TableOfContents) (59-64), right = GameCultOverviewSidebar and Backlinks under slug conditions (65-80); list layout left = GameCultOverviewSidebar() (97). Both become left: [], right: []. isIntegratedDossierPage is then unused and goes; isGraphPage, isThingPage, isStandardContentPage, isBlogArticle stay (beforeBody uses them). Plugin.TableOfContents() leaves site/quartz.config.ts transformers (line 78): its only consumer was the TOC component.

The engine still renders <div class="left sidebar"> and <div class="right sidebar"> (GameCult-Quartz renderPage.tsx 247-262); both are empty on every page after this cut. The engine is not edited. The site's conditional grid (:empty display none 52-55; the two :has(... :empty) blocks 57-87) is replaced by one unconditional rule written where 52 was: .page > #quartz-body { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: "grid-header" "grid-center" "grid-footer"; } and .page > #quartz-body > .left.sidebar, .page > #quartz-body > .right.sidebar { display: none; } (that selector, specificity (1,3,0), beats the engine's mobile .sidebar.left { display: flex }; the plain .sidebar form would not).

The tagline chain (gamecult.ts 467-508) stays: headerTagline is the page's own quoted first line, else the nearest section index's. Only the carrier changes: findSidebarOverviewNote becomes findSectionNote (same candidates, no sidebarSource lookup) and the context is { headerTagline } only. The Blog literal 'Recent notes, fiction, experiments, and other escaped materials.' moves into GameCult/Blog/index.md as its first body line, *"..."*, so extractTopTagline reads it for /Blog and every post; the two code copies (gamecult.ts 498 and the sidebarTagline/sidebarSummary options in GameCultContent.tsx) go. Verify the /Blog article does not also print the line (AutoIndexFolder renders the description intro and the list, not the body tree); if it does, stripTopTagline on the Blog tree is the fix, not a second literal.

Delete from gamecult.ts: the buildAutoIndexSidebarData import (6); GameCultSidebarLink, GameCultSidebarGroup, GameCultSidebarData (8-26); the sidebar field of GameCultPageContext (30); FrontmatterSidebarLink, FrontmatterSidebarGroup (33-43); isSidebarLinkActive (154-169); collectLinks (253-277); extractOverviewSummary (279-305); extractOverviewGroups (307-342); extractFrontmatterOverviewGroups (344-408); extractOverviewData (450-465); the sidebar build in buildGameCultPageContext (491-507). resolveGameCultSourceFile loses its field parameter (only contentSource remains; no content sets sidebarSource). isOverviewSlug and overviewCandidates stay under findSectionNote.

Content: delete the sidebarGroups blocks from GameCult/index.md (6-51), GameCult/Docs/Architecture-and-Evidence.md (6-29), GameCult/Pitch.md (8-28), GameCult/tour.md (6-60 at base; one less after composite-delete), and every enableToc line (nine files: rg -l enableToc GameCult). Nothing the groups linked moves inline: the masthead nav, the home action row and body links, and the Projects atlas already reach all of it, and /Blog is the post list (map C3).

CSS, all in custom.scss, by selector: the :empty and :has grid rules (52-87); .page > #quartz-body .left.sidebar (94-101); the ritual block's grid override and its left/right sidebar rules (127-141) and its five .right.sidebar .toc rules (158-195) and its max-width 760px grid override and right-sidebar hide (570-583); .left.sidebar:has(.gamecult-overview-sidebar) (625-629).

CSS, continued: the colossus block's grid override and sidebar hide (1100-1111); .page > #quartz-body .right.sidebar (1128-1135); .toc, .backlinks and their h3 (1137-1159); every .gamecult-overview-* rule (1161-1274); the @media not ($desktop) block holding the left sidebar, overview sidebar and right sidebar rules (1312-1330, the whole block); the .page > #quartz-body grid-template-areas rule inside @media ($mobile) (1333-1340); .gamecult-overview-sidebar-inner inside @media ($mobile) (1384-1386); the two sidebar lines of the tour/Pitch hider selector list (1412-1413). The tour/Pitch block's own grid-template-columns/rows/areas (1402-1409) stay: that block owns the full-screen page.
Pills, masthead markup, the engine, the wash and the width caps: untouched (column-align takes the caps).

authority_map.owner: quartz.layout.ts owns what a page places: nothing beside the centre. custom.scss owns the page grid through one rule. gamecult.ts owns the masthead tagline chain; content owns each tagline, Blog/index.md the blog's.
inputs: the page's and its section index's first quoted line
the engine's grid areas grid-header, grid-center, grid-footer
outputs: no sidebar, TOC, backlinks or overview DOM on any page; every page a single grid column at every width
the masthead tagline identical to today on every page
derived_state: the grid is no longer derived from sidebar emptiness (:has, :empty); it is one rule; the slug blocks no longer override it
the tagline is derived from content, never from sidebar data; the Blog tagline has one owner, Blog/index.md
enableToc, sidebarGroups, sidebarSource, sidebarTagline and sidebarSummary are read by nothing and are deleted, not left inert
forbidden_writers: no left or right entry in either layout; no component under site/quartz/components named or styled as a sidebar
no grid-template-* for #quartz-body outside the one rule and the tour/Pitch full-screen block; no :has or :empty grid rule
no change to the engine, the pills, the masthead markup, the wash, .page's width or any width cap
shared_paths: every page type renders through the one grid rule; ContentPage and FolderPage share GameCultContent; the same Deploy Quartz workflow
authority_map.deletion_line: The placements, the component, the data model, the TOC transformer, the frontmatter and all sidebar CSS are deleted first; the one grid rule, findSectionNote and the Blog tagline line are written after.

builds: Deploy Quartz green on the landing commit: gh run list -R GameCult/gamecult-site -w "Deploy Quartz" -L 1
optional: .\scripts\quartz\quartz.ps1 build succeeds locally (TypeScript must compile with the removed exports)
